prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Perfect Desktop Companion", "Select a companion style to bring your desktop pet to life."]
1: ["Give Your Desktop Pet a Name", "Personalize your companion before creating their desktop profile.", "Companion Name"]
2: ["Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop", "Click and drag your pet anywhere on your screen. Access settings from the system tray."]
3: ["Sign In to Protect Your Pet Data", "Keep your companion settings, custom look, and adoption progress safe in the cloud."]
4: ["How Would You Like to Create Your Desktop Pet?", "Pick instant companion adoption for quick setup, or photo upload to customize."]
5: ["Your desktop pet comes pre-equipped with a starter interactive ball toy on your screen.", "Included: Desktop Starter Accessory"]
6: ["Feel free to use other apps. We will notify you as soon as your desktop companion is ready."]
7: ["Companion setup usually takes 1 to 2 minutes."]
8: ["Signing in links your pet to your account so progress and custom looks are saved."]
9: ["Use well-lit, front-facing photos for best desktop rendering quality."]
